title: Quiet money (batch 5): the quant-finance data cluster, quiet European AI money, and quiet Asian power
source: Public record: SEC/ADV filings; FEC/OpenSecrets; company histories; Aleph Alpha/Schwarz + C3.ai filings; CK Hutchison/BlackRock 2025 ports deal. Catalog layer (#242 batch 5). Structural overlay; person nodes carry dossiers. FOCUS: the low-profile quant/data-finance fortunes that industrialized ML before Big Tech, plus quiet foreign money in AI + strategic infrastructure. HONESTY: holdings/donations/deals = fact; influence graded; no cabal imputed.

edges.notes: Jim Simons (mathematician/codebreaker; d. 2024) founded Renaissance Technologies + the Medallion fund - the most successful quant fund ever + the origin of the industrialized-data-in-finance model; the Simons Foundation is a top private math/science funder (fact).
Robert Mercer succeeded Simons as RenTech co-CEO - the bridge from the (apolitical) Simons era to the (political) Mercer data-politics project (fact); wires to the quiet-money data-politics thread.
Ken Griffin founded + runs Citadel (the ~$60B+ multi-strategy hedge fund) - and is among the very largest, increasingly political GOP mega-donors (Harvard, museums, Florida) (fact).

Griffin also controls Citadel Securities - the dominant US market-maker handling a huge share of retail equity/options order flow (payment-for-order-flow; central to the 2021 GameStop/Robinhood episode) - quiet control of market plumbing (fact).
Citadel Securities is the largest buyer of Robinhood's order flow (PFOF) - the arrangement at the center of the retail-trading + market-structure debate (fact).
David E. Shaw (computer scientist) founded D. E. Shaw - a pioneering quant fund + a computational-biology powerhouse (DE Shaw Research); a quiet centibillionaire-adjacent scientist (fact).
Jeff Bezos worked at DE Shaw (where the Amazon idea was hatched) - the quant-fund-to-Big-Tech origin story (fact).
Two Sigma's founders (Overdeck, Siegel) came out of DE Shaw - the quant-diaspora that built the data-finance cluster (fact).
Izzy Englander founded Millennium Management - a ~$70B multi-manager 'pod shop'; among the largest + lowest-profile hedge-fund fortunes (fact).
Millennium/Citadel/RenTech/DE Shaw/Two Sigma are the quant cluster that industrialized data + ML in markets before Big Tech - a distinct, quiet AI-capital pole (fact of category).
Dieter Schwarz - Germany's richest, near-invisible owner of the Schwarz Group (Lidl + Kaufland) - Europe's largest retailer (fact).
Schwarz Group (via Schwarz Digits) is a lead backer of Aleph Alpha - Germany's sovereign-AI LLM champion - and runs StackIT cloud; retail cash pivoting into European sovereign AI/compute (fact).
Schwarz Digits builds European datacenters/cloud (data-sovereignty pitch) - quiet retail money into the AI-infrastructure buildout (fact).
Aleph Alpha is Europe's flagship 'sovereign' LLM lab (Heidelberg) - the EU's bid for AI independence from US/China models (fact; commercial pivot to tooling 2024).
Tom Siebel (Siebel Systems -> Oracle) founded + runs C3.ai - enterprise + government AI (defense, energy, intelligence) - a quieter enterprise-AI fortune (fact).
C3.ai supplies AI to the DoD/Air Force/intelligence + energy agencies - enterprise AI embedded in government (fact).
Li Ka-shing - Hong Kong's quiet magnate - controls CK Hutchison (ports, telecom, retail, infrastructure across ~50 countries) - a low-profile globe-spanning empire (fact).

2025: CK Hutchison agreed to sell 43 ports (incl. two at the Panama Canal) to a BlackRock-led consortium (~$23B) - a geopolitically charged transfer of strategic infrastructure amid US-China pressure (fact; deal under review).
Griffin is a top-tier GOP + establishment donor (and funds elite universities/museums) - quiet market-structure wealth converted to political + cultural influence (fact).
